title: Hakodate, Hokkaido — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Hakodate, Hokkaido: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Hakodate is a city in Hokkaido with a population of 265,000. A historic port city with a stunning night view from Mount Hakodate, fresh seafood, and early Western architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
